name: CaseBoxShadowOkColorRing
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "box-shadow-ok-color-ring" (effects). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a two-layer box-shadow whose RING layer is spelled in an OKLab colour space — `0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.5), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.05)` (Tailwind v4 / shadcn's focus ring, verbatim from examples/shadcn/tokens/shadcn-minted.dtcg.json)
